headline: Customs Reform Will Make Imports More Expensive in Quintana Roo, Comce Warns
summary: Comce, a Mexican foreign trade council, warned that customs reform will make imports more expensive in Quintana Roo. It named official discretion as the largest risk.
why: Customs rules and tariffs set the cost of importing goods. Changes in them affect import-dependent businesses and regional trade flows.
original_headline: Reforma aduanera encarecerá importaciones en Quintana Roo, advierte Comce
